segment.source: Protect a cargo transfer during an attack by Imperial frigates. Eliminate the TIE Bombers while dogfighting the TIE Advanced.
segment.target: 在遭受帝國巡防艦 突襲期間掩護貨物轉移。 在與先進型鈦戰機 近身纏鬥的同時， 迅速消滅鈦轟炸機。

segment.source: A pair of cargo containers has been hidden away in an asteroid field.
segment.target: 一組貨物貨櫃已被祕密隱藏於一處小行星帶中。

segment.source: A-wing [[Red One]] will inspect the containers to verify their contents.
segment.target: A翼戰機[[紅一號]]將就近檢視貨櫃以確認其貨物內容。

segment.source: Two transports will then deploy to ferry the supplies to our cruiser.
segment.target: 隨後兩艘運輸船將進場將物資轉運至我們的巡洋艦。

segment.source: This will require at least two or three trips, so remain alert.
segment.target: 這至少需要往返運送兩至三趟，請時刻保持戒備。

segment.source: Attack any Imperial patrols instantly! We can not allow any interference!
segment.target: 一經發現帝國巡邏隊立即開火！絕不容許任何敵軍干擾！

segment.source: X-wing [[Gold ]]and B-wing [[Blue]] will be on the alert in case of trouble.
segment.target: X翼[[金隊]]與 B翼[[藍隊]]將在遭遇突發危險時提供警戒支援。

segment.source: As soon as the [[Stimsenj'kat]] has entered hyperspace, you should, too.
segment.target: 一旦[[斯汀森卡特號]]進入超空間，你也應隨即跳躍撤離。

segment.source: 1) Cargo container group[[ Xi]] must be inspected.$$2) Calamari Cruiser [[Stimsenj'kat]] must survive. The cruiser will enter hyperspace when the transports have completed their mission.$$3) Transport group [[Renhoek]] must survive. There are two replacement waves that must also dock with the containers to complete their mission.
segment.target: 1) 必須檢視貨物貨櫃群[[克西]]。$$2) 蒙卡拉馬里巡洋艦[[斯汀森卡特號]]必須存活。巡洋艦將在運輸船完成任務後跳入超空間。$$3) 運輸船編隊[[雷恩霍克號]]必須存活。另有兩波接替船隊亦必須與貨櫃對接以完成任務。

segment.source: First is an independent group of four Assault Gunboats (whose primary targets are the containers and transports.) They are joined by two Nebulon-B class Frigates, each with two TIE squadrons. The TIEs are an even mix of TIE Bombers and TIE Advanced. Upon the destruction of the first Frigate a third will arrive.$ The Bombers' primary target is the Cruiser. The TIE Advanceds' primary targets are Alliance fighters.
segment.target: 首先是一隊由四架突擊砲艇組成的獨立編隊（其首要目標為貨櫃與運輸船）。隨後兩艘各搭載兩個鈦戰機中隊的內布隆-B 級巡防艦將加入戰場。敵機由數量均等的鈦轟炸機與先進型鈦戰機組成。一旦第一艘巡防艦被擊沉，第三艘巡防艦隨即抵達。$轟炸機的首要目標為我方巡洋艦，而先進型鈦戰機的首要目標為同盟戰機。

segment.source: The Empire's first deployment of an advanced TIE fighter with defensive shields was less than momentous. The new craft were faster than anything else in wide use at the time, but were badly underarmed.$ In this battle three squadrons were lost in combat against a single Calamari Cruiser. Of course, there was one Alliance pilot who greatly distinguished himself on that day... accounting for over 30 enemy craft!
segment.target: 帝國首次部署裝備防護護盾的先進型鈦戰機，其戰果遠未達到預期。這款新戰機雖比當時普及的任何戰機都要迅速，但武裝嚴重貧弱。$在此役中，三個敵機中隊在面對單一一艘蒙卡拉馬里巡洋艦時被全數殲滅。當然，那天有一位同盟飛行員威震全場……單機斬獲了超過三十架敵機！

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ THIS IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>本任務已提供$>過關戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索破關之道，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點擊黑色頁碼方塊$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: IDing the CONs triggers the arrival of GUN[[ Rho]]. Engage them immediately to prevent them from destroying the TRNs.$ When the FRGs arrive and begin launching their TIEs, go after the Bombers first. X-W[[ Gold]] will help you while B-W[[ Blue]] concentrates on the Frigates. When there are no more T/Bs, go after the T/As. (X-W[[ Gold]] should then join B-W[[ Blue]] against the FRGs.)
segment.target: 完成貨櫃辨識將觸發突擊砲艇[[羅（GUN Rho）]]的進場。立即迎擊以阻止他們摧毀我方運輸船。$當巡防艦抵達並開始出動鈦戰機時，優先追擊轟炸機。X翼[[金隊]]會協助你，而 B翼[[藍隊]]則專注攻擊巡防艦。當轟炸機全滅後，再對付先進型鈦戰機。（屆時 X翼[[金隊]]應轉向協助 B翼[[藍隊]]合力攻打巡防艦。）

segment.source: Your mission goals are simple: verify the contents of the containers, then ensure the safety of the transfer operation. Transport group[[ Renhoek]] is most vulnerable so be sure to keep watch over them.$ The greatest threat to our Cruiser would be a torpedo attack, so be prepared to intercept any Imperial craft that could launch one. Stay alert and stay alive!
segment.target: 你的任務目標很簡單：核實貨櫃貨物，並確保轉運作業的絕對安全。運輸船編隊[[雷恩霍克號]]最易受損，務必全程警戒護衛。$對我方巡洋艦最大的威脅莫過於魚雷突襲，請隨時準備攔截任何具備魚雷發射能力的帝國機艦。保持警惕，平安活著回來！
運輸船 雷恩霍克號
巡洋艦 斯汀森卡特號

segment.source: Outstanding, Red 1! You're an inspiration to us all!
segment.target: 卓越非凡，紅一號！你是全體同袍的榜樣！

segment.source: Perhaps one day you will be remembered as the ...
segment.target: 也許有朝一日你將作為……

segment.source: ... greatest A-wing pilot of all time!
segment.target: ……有史以來最偉大的 A翼戰機王牌飛行員名垂青史！

segment.source: Destroy a large Imperial troop convoy as part of a combined strike team made up of X-wings, A-wings and B-wings.
segment.target: 作為由 X翼、A翼 與 B翼組成的聯合突擊編隊 核心，全力摧毀一支 龐大的帝國佔領軍船隊。

segment.source: A large Imperial convoy bearing occupation troops is the target.
segment.target: 目標為一支載運大量佔領軍部隊的龐大帝國護航船隊。

segment.source: Stormtrooper[[ Transports]] and bulk[[ Freighters]] make up the convoy.
segment.target: 該船隊由帝國衝鋒隊[[運輸船]]與大型[[散裝貨船]]組成。

segment.source: The convoy contains [[40]] freighters and [[60]] troop transports.
segment.target: 船隊總計包含[[40]]艘貨船與[[60]]艘部隊運輸船。

segment.source: At least half of the convoy must be destroyed.
segment.target: 必須至少摧毀該船隊半數以上的船艦。

segment.source: The strike force will consist of [[4]] X-wings, [[4]] B-wings and [[4]] A-wings.
segment.target: 突擊部隊由[[4]]架 X翼、[[4]]架 B翼與[[4]]架 A翼戰機組成。

segment.source: X-wing[[ Red ]]will take the transports, B-wing [[Gold]] will take the freighters.
segment.target: X翼[[紅隊]]負責攻擊運輸船，B翼[[金隊]]負責攻擊貨船。

segment.source: A-wing[[ Blue]] will cover the attack by engaging any escort fighters.
segment.target: A翼[[藍隊]]將迎擊護航戰機，提供全程防空掩護。

segment.source: 1) Transport group [[Epsilon]] must be destroyed. (There are 30 ships arriving in 5 six ship flight groups.)$$2) Freighter group [[M-S]] must be destroyed. (There are 20 ships arriving in pairs.)
segment.target: 1) 必須摧毀運輸船編隊[[艾普西隆]]。（共有 30 艘船，分 5 個編隊各 6 艘陸續抵達。）$$2) 必須摧毀貨船編隊[[M-S]]。（共有 20 艘船，成對陸續抵達。）

segment.source: The troop transports in the convoy will fight back. Additionally, a heavy squadron (20 ships) of Assault Gunboats are providing escort. They will arrive in pairs.$ A Star Destroyer will arrive after about 20 minutes. It has a full complement of TIEs. There are three squadrons of TIE Fighters, two squadrons of TIE Interceptors and one squadron of TIE Bombers.
segment.target: 船隊中的部隊運輸船具備防禦還擊火力。此外，一個由 20 架突擊砲艇組成的重型中隊正實施護航，他們將成對抵達戰場。$約 20 分鐘後，一艘滅星艦將會趕抵，該艦搭載完整編制的鈦戰機：包括三個鈦戰機中隊、兩個鈦截擊機中隊與一個鈦轟炸機中隊。

segment.source: After the Battle of Hoth, the Empire fell victim to overconfidence. Believing the Alliance to have been so devastated that they would be incapable of launching any new attacks, a major troop convoy was left with minimal escort.$ The ensuing raid was a triumph! Striking a mortal blow to the Empire while still reeling from the loss at Hoth proved to all the resilience of the Rebellion.
segment.target: 在霍斯戰役之後，帝國陷入了自大輕敵的泥潭。誤以為同盟遭受毀滅性打擊而無力發動反撲，帝國竟然僅為一支重要部隊船隊配置了極薄弱的護航。$隨之而來的突擊戰大獲全勝！在剛承受霍斯慘敗的震盪之際，我們給予帝國致命重擊，向全銀河展現了反抗軍堅韌不屈的作戰意志。

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS$>FOR COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ THIS IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER$>BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>本任務已提供$>過關戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索破關之道，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點擊黑色頁碼方塊$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: Aggressively attack TRN [[Epsilon]]. A-W[[ Blue]] will keep the Gunboats occupied. Help them out when the opportunity presents itself, but concentrate on the Transports. Similarly, B-W[[ Gold]] will take care of the Freighters, but you can always speed things up when you see a Freighter with its shields down.$ Try to save your torpedoes for the Star Destroyer's shield generator towers!
segment.target: 果斷猛攻運輸船[[艾普西隆]]。A翼[[藍隊]]會牽制住敵方突擊砲艇。伺機提供協助，但主要精力仍應放在運輸船上。同樣地，B翼[[金隊]]會對付貨船，但當你看到護盾已被擊破的貨船時，隨手補火能加快清場節奏。$盡量保留魚雷，留給稍後進場的滅星艦護盾產生器塔！

segment.source: In this mission you will need to demonstrate a lot of stamina! The convoy is very large and destroying even just half of it will take awhile.$ Since you'll be leading the X-wing group, you'll be in the "swing" position. This means that, (as opportunity or necessity dictates), your group will assist the B-wings and/or the A-wings with their mission goals.$ Good luck! ... You'll need it!
segment.target: 在此任務中你必須展現頑強的持久戰鬥力！該船隊規模極大，即便只消滅半數也需耗費相當長的時間。$作為 X翼編隊的長官，你處於「機動策應」陣位。這意味著（視戰局需要或戰機出現時），你的編隊應適時協助 B翼或 A翼達成其任務目標。$祝你好運！……你絕對需要它！
泰爾戈恩德爾塔級 Dx-9 運輸船

segment.source: Fantastic job, Red 1, you're on your way to becoming a legend
segment.target: 令人驚嘆的出色戰果，紅一號，你正在邁向傳奇之路！

segment.source: Perhaps one day you will be remembered as the ...
segment.target: 也許有朝一日你將作為……

segment.source: ... greatest X-wing pilot of all time!
segment.target: ……有史以來最偉大的 X翼戰機王牌飛行員名垂青史！

segment.source: Lead the assault on an Imperial Star Destroyer that is vulnerable during a resupply operation. Cover the capture of enemy supplies.
segment.target: 率隊突擊一艘在進行 補給作業時露出破綻的 帝國滅星艦。 掩護繳獲敵軍物資的作戰。

segment.source: An Imperial Star Destroyer will be vulnerable during a resupply stop.
segment.target: 一艘帝國滅星艦在補給停泊期間防備薄弱、露出致命破綻。

segment.source: Critical supplies have been delivered and must be transferred.
segment.target: 關鍵物資已被運抵現場，敵軍正準備進行物資轉移。

segment.source: Clear the TIE fighter defenses and knock out the Star Destroyer.
segment.target: 清除鈦戰機防禦力量，並重創摧毀該滅星艦。

segment.source: Any craft attempting to escape are also to be attacked.
segment.target: 任何企圖脫逃的敵機艦亦一律予以打擊。

segment.source: The strike force will consist of [[4]] X-wings, [[4]] B-wings and [[4]] A-wings.
segment.target: 突擊部隊由[[4]]架 X翼、[[4]]架 B翼與[[4]]架 A翼戰機組成。

segment.source: X-wing[[ Gold ]]and B-wing[[ Red]] will attack the Star Destroyer.
segment.target: X翼[[金隊]]與 B翼[[紅隊]]將聯手向滅星艦發起突擊。

segment.source: A-wing[[ Blue]] will cover the attack by clearing the TIE fighter defenses.
segment.target: A翼[[藍隊]]將清除鈦戰機防線，掩護我方主力突擊。

segment.source: B-wing [[Red ]]will also be responsible for stopping any craft from escaping.
segment.target: B翼[[紅隊]]同時負責阻止任何敵方艦艇脫逃。

segment.source: If all goes well, FRT[[ Schwa]] will arrive to empty the cargo containers.
segment.target: 若一切順利，貨船[[施瓦號]]將會抵達現場打撈接收貨物貨櫃。

segment.source: 1) Imperial Star Destroyer[[ Kotiate]] must be destroyed.$$2) Shuttle group[[ Lambda]] must be destroyed.
segment.target: 1) 帝國滅星艦[[柯蒂亞特號]]必須被摧毀。$$2) 穿梭機編隊[[藍布達]]必須被摧毀。

segment.source: The Star Destroyer is at full alert. Its six TIE squadrons are at full strength. The squadrons are divided by type in the standard three TIE Fighter, two TIE Interceptor and one TIE Bomber mix.$ A Nebulon-B class Frigate will arrive to reinforce. It has two squadrons of TIE Advanced. The escape Shuttles will launch shortly after it arrives.
segment.target: 該滅星艦處於全級戒備狀態，其下轄六個鈦戰機中隊皆保持滿編。中隊按標準配比由三個鈦戰機中隊、兩個鈦截擊機中隊與一個鈦轟炸機中隊組成。$一艘內布隆-B 級巡防艦將會跳入戰場增援，配備有兩個先進型鈦戰機中隊。巡防艦抵達後不久，逃亡穿梭機便會起飛脫逃。

segment.source: This mission recreates the last time an Imperial class Star Destroyer was destroyed by taking advantage of its "Achilles' heel." After this the remaining vessels in the class were all subjected to a time-consuming and expensive shield system upgrade.$ B-wing [[Red]] led the attack, with [[Red One]] taking down the shield generator towers. An Imperial Frigate carrying Advanced TIEs was also destroyed.
segment.target: 本任務重現了同盟最後一次利用「阿基里斯之踵」致命弱點擊沉帝國級滅星艦的經典戰役。在此役之後，該級艦的所有殘存船艦均被迫接受了耗時且極其昂貴的護盾系統升級改造。$B翼[[紅隊]]主導了這次進攻，由[[紅一號]]親手摧毀了其護盾產生器塔。一艘載有先進型鈦戰機的帝國巡防艦亦被一同葬送。

segment.source: Waste no time taking down the shield generator towers on top of the STD's bridge superstructure. The fastest way to do this is with torpedoes, [[3]] per tower.$ Order your wingmen to attack TRN [[Sigma 1]] while you make your first pass. Build up your shields on the way in, then redirect all power to the engines for maximum speed. When the STD's shields go down, switch to ion cannons and disable it!
segment.target: 抓緊時間，第一時間摧毀滅星艦艦橋上層結構頂部的護盾產生器塔。最快的方式是發射魚雷，每座塔耗費[[3]]枚魚雷。$在進行第一次進攻航線時，命令你的僚機攻擊運輸船[[西格瑪 1 號]]。進場時將護盾充飽，隨後將所有動力轉至引擎以獲取最高航速。當滅星艦護盾崩潰時，切換至離子砲將其癱瘓！

segment.source: $>STRATEGY AND TACTICS FOR$>COMPLETING THIS MISSION$>ARE AVAILABLE.$$$>DO NOT READ THIS IF YOU WISH TO$>DISCOVER THESE FOR YOURSELF!$$$>CLICK ON THE BLACK PAGE NUMBER >BOX TO SEE THE HINT(S).
segment.target: $>本任務已提供$>過關戰略與戰術建議。$$$>若你想親自探索破關之道，$>請勿閱讀以下內容！$$$>點擊黑色頁碼方塊$>即可查看提示內容。

segment.source: As the leader of the B-wing group your primary responsibility will be the destruction of the shield towers. They are located on top of the command bridge superstructure. Once the shields are down, switch to ion cannons and disable the Star Destroyer as quickly as you can.$ Be sure to watch for any small craft attempting to escape the area. This is a "take no prisoners" attack!
segment.target: 作為 B翼編隊的長官，你的第一職責便是摧毀護盾塔。它們坐落於指揮艦橋上層建築頂端。一旦護盾崩解，立即切換為離子砲並盡快癱瘓該滅星艦。$務必嚴密監視任何企圖逃離該空域的小型船艇。這是一場「不留活口、全面殲滅」的強襲！
滅星艦 柯蒂亞特號

segment.source: Excellent job, Red 1! Your fighting skills are amazing!
segment.target: 極其出色的戰果，紅一號！你的戰鬥技巧令人嘆為觀止！

segment.source: Perhaps one day you will be remembered as the ...
segment.target: 也許有朝一日你將作為……

segment.source: ... greatest B-wing pilot of all time!
segment.target: ……有史以來最偉大的 B翼戰機王牌飛行員名垂青史！

segment.source: Protect a convoy under attack by Imperial forces in the Mennaalii system. This convoy is transporting Rebel troops. Many lives are at stake.
segment.target: 在門納利星系中， 掩護遭到帝國軍襲擊的 護航船隊。該船隊正載運 反抗軍部隊， 關乎無數同袍性命。

segment.source: A convoy passing through the [[Mennaalii]] system is under attack.
segment.target: 一支途經[[門納利星系]]的護航船隊正遭受敵軍圍攻。

segment.source: The convoy dropped out of hyper- space to avoid an asteroid field.
segment.target: 船隊為規避小行星帶而脫離了超空間。

segment.source: Here they were ambushed by a band of pirates.
segment.target: 在此處他們遭到了一夥海盜的埋伏襲擊。

segment.source: In the struggle for survival we find ourselves under the constant threat of attack, not only by the Imperial Navy but by countless pirates and hostile cultures as well. Nevertheless, we will survive. With the help of brave and skilled pilots like you, we have been able to strike at the enemy with victorious battles and successful missions. Now, most important is the defense of our own people. Again you are called upon to save lives.
segment.target: 在求生的艱苦抗爭中，我們時刻面臨著威脅——不僅來自帝國海軍，亦來自無數星際海盜與敵對勢力。然而，我們必將生生不息。在如你般英勇善戰的王牌飛行員奮戰下，我們歷經一次次勝利戰役重擊強敵。如今，最緊要的莫過於保衛我們自己的同胞。我們再次召喚你挺身而出，拯救生命。

segment.source: A Rebel troop convoy is under attack by pirates equipped with craft like ours. There are pirate Y-wings and A-wings already in the battle. Use your CMD to ID each craft to confirm it is unfriendly before engaging. The Y-wings pose the biggest threat to the convoy with their torpedoes so concentrate on them first. The primary goal is to ensure the safety of the convoy. You must save all the Corvettes and our troops onboard.
segment.target: 一支反抗軍部隊船隊正遭受裝備與我軍同型戰機的海盜襲擊。海盜的 Y翼與 A翼已投入交火。開火前務必使用作戰顯示器（CMD）核實敵我辨識。海盜的 Y翼憑藉魚雷對船隊構成最致命威脅，因此請優先予以擊落。核心目標是力保船隊安全，你必須保全所有巡邏艦及艦載部隊。

segment.source: First destroy all the Y-wings using lasers. Then concentrate on the X-wings. The X-wings will launch torpedoes at the Corvettes. If you use torpedoes against the X-wings, increase your speed before launching. The next craft to stop are the Transports. They will target the Corvettes. The last real threat to stop are the Gunboat scouts that enter and attack the Corvettes. The A-wings are only a threat to you.
segment.target: 首先使用雷射砲消滅所有 Y翼。隨後集中對付 X翼，X翼會向巡邏艦發射魚雷。若對 X翼使用魚雷，發射前請先加速。接下來必須攔截的是運輸船，他們會瞄準巡邏艦。最後真正的威脅是進場突擊巡邏艦的砲艇偵察機。敵方 A翼則僅對你構成威脅。

segment.source: Your mission is to protect the convoy and drive off the pirates.
segment.target: 你的任務是掩護船隊並驅逐擊潰海盜。

segment.source: YOUR MISSION HAS BEEN ACCOMPLISHED RED 1!
YOU HELPED SAVE THE CONVOY RED 1, GOOD JOB!
segment.target: 紅一號，你協助拯救了整個船隊，幹得好！

segment.source: YOU MAY RETURN HOME WHEN YOU WISH
Attack an Imperial weapons stockyard made up of several containers. This will be a suprise attack with lots of targets.
segment.target: 突擊由多個貨櫃 組成的帝國武器補給基地。 這將是一場目標繁多的 出其不意奇襲戰。

segment.source: Our intelligence has located a lightly defended Imperial [[weapons stockyard.]]
segment.target: 我軍情報部門查明了一處防禦薄弱的帝國[[武器儲備基地]]。

segment.source: The facility is a perfect target for one of our [[hit and run]] attacks.
segment.target: 該設施是實施[[打了就跑]]突襲戰術的絕佳目標。

segment.source: You will fly a [[B-wing ]]and use its torpedoes to destroy all containers.
segment.target: 你將駕駛一架[[B翼戰機]]，運用其魚雷摧毀所有貨櫃。

segment.source: Here you will get the opportunity to fly the [[B-wing]] on an [[assault]] mission. The B-wing's larger payload makes it a good craft for attacking multiple targets. We have picked a Container Stockyard for you to practice your assault skills. There were little to no defenses at last report. You will be assigned three wingmen to assist you in this task.$ [[Your objective is to destroy all the Containers in the area.]]
segment.target: 在此你將有機會駕駛[[B翼戰機]]執行[[突擊]]任務。B翼充沛的載彈量使其成為打擊多目標的利器。我們挑選了一處貨櫃物資庫供你磨練突擊戰術。最新情報顯示該處幾乎無實質防禦。你將獲配三名僚機支援此次任務。$[[你的核心目標是摧毀該區域內的所有貨櫃。]]

segment.source: First take out all the [[Shuttles]] with lasers. Note that some Shuttles start off behind you! Attack the [[Corvettes]] next using your torpedoes. Quickly destroy the [[Containers]]. Assign your wingmen to help often. When Gunboats [[Nu]] enter the area, make them a priority. They want you dead.$ If you feel you need extra help, destroy the disabled [[TUG]] named [[Empleh]]. This will call in some reserve X-wings to help in the battle.
segment.target: 首先用雷射砲消滅所有[[穿梭機]]。注意部分穿梭機一開始就在你的身後！隨後用魚雷打擊[[巡邏艦]]。迅速摧毀[[貨櫃]]。經常命令僚機協同火力。當突擊砲艇[[紐（Nu）]]進場時，優先解決他們，他們誓要取你性命。$若你自覺需要額外增援，擊毀名為[[恩普勒號（Empleh）]]的受損[[拖船]]，這將呼叫預備隊 X翼戰機跳入戰場前來支援。

segment.source: YOU HAVE ACCOMPLISHED YOUR MISSION RED 1!
YOU HELPED TO ELIMINATE AN IMPERIAL WEAPONS STOCKYARD
segment.target: 你協助殲滅了一處帝國軍備物資庫

segment.source: YOU MAY RETURN HOME AT ANY TIME NOW
segment.target: 你現在隨時可以返航基地

segment.source: Scramble to save your mothership by intercepting TIE Bombers that are making torpedo runs on your cruiser.
segment.target: 緊急升空！ 攔截正向我方巡洋艦實施 魚雷俯衝攻擊的 鈦轟炸機， 全力保衛母艦！

segment.source: Imperial reconnaissance patrols have located our [[Cruiser Excelsior]].
segment.target: 帝國偵察巡邏隊發現了我方[[埃克塞爾西奧號巡洋艦]]。

segment.source: The Imperial [[FRG Blue Fox]] has already launched an attack against her.
segment.target: 帝國[[藍狐號巡防艦]]已向其發起了猛攻。

segment.source: Two A-wings from Red group are intercepting the attacking bombers.
segment.target: 來自紅隊的兩架 A翼戰機正緊急攔截進攻的轟炸機。

segment.source: Y-wings and X-wings will be armed, then launched against the Frigate.
segment.target: Y翼與 X翼戰機正加裝彈藥，隨後將出動打擊巡防艦。

segment.source: Break time is over. As usual we are on the run. An Imperial Frigate has hyper-jumped into the area and is launching TIE Bombers. We could stand our ground and defeat the Frigate, but since more Imperials are no doubt on the way here, the orders are to retreat. It will take about twenty minutes to reach our jump point which is in the direction of the Frigate.$ [[The primary objective is the survival of our Cruiser]].[[ ]]
segment.target: 休整時間結束，正如往常，我們又處於撤退航線上。一艘帝國巡防艦已跳入該空域並正在出動鈦轟炸機。我們本可堅守陣地擊沉該艦，但鑑於後續帝國增援無疑正疾馳而來，最高命令是全面撤退。前往位於巡防艦方向的超空間跳躍點約需二十分鐘。$[[核心目標是力保我方巡洋艦存活。]][[ ]]

segment.source: Stop all the [[TIE Bombers]] as quickly as possible, hopefully before they get a chance to launch too many of their torpedoes. You need to destroy the two [[Gunboats]] [[Mu]] behind the first wave of TIE Bombers. Use the [[Cruiser]] for cover and support fire if you get into trouble. Save at least 4 missiles to use on TIE Bombers [[Eta]] who want to eliminate you. You can safely fire on the [[Corvettes]] while they are attacking the Cruiser.
segment.target: 以最快速度攔截所有[[鈦轟炸機]]，最好在他們來得及傾瀉魚雷前將其摧毀。你必須擊毀第一波鈦轟炸機後方的兩架[[突擊砲艇]][[繆（Mu）]]。若陷入困境，請利用[[巡洋艦]]作為掩體並獲取支援砲火。保留至少 4 枚飛彈對付誓要獵殺你的鈦轟炸機[[艾塔（Eta）]]。當敵方[[巡邏艦]]攻擊巡洋艦時，你可從容自其背後開火射擊。
巡洋艦 埃克塞爾西奧號

segment.source: YOU HAVE ACCOMPLISHED YOUR MISSION RED 1!
YOU HELPED TO SAVE ALL OF OUR LIVES!
segment.target: 你拯救了我們所有人的性命！
